title: Civil Engineer FIFO
screening_questions: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
What's your expected annual base salary?
How many years' experience do you have as a civil engineer?
How much notice are you required to give your current employer?
Do you have experience in a FIFO/DIDO role?
rationale: Direct civil contractor (WA and NSW) hiring a Civil Engineer on a FIFO 2/1 roster; it asks for a civil engineering degree and highly regards graduate or site engineer experience and a White Card, which Marc has (BSCE, White Card, FIFO availability on record).

Duties of reading drawings, site inspections, coordinating labour, materials and subcontractors, and assisting with earthworks, roads, drainage and pavement design trace to his Philippines site work and his Advanced Diploma design work.
Cost estimation, quantity measurement and variations are coursework only for Marc, and his site experience is under one year and outside Australia.
caution: The advert says skilled and experienced; Marc is at graduate level with under one year of site work in the Philippines. FIFO base is Perth WA, so the fly in point needs Marc's confirmation. Cost and variations experience is coursework only.
gaps: Cost estimation and quantities from coursework, no variations management
Has not worked a FIFO roster before
Perth base: relocation or fly in point not confirmed by Marc
apply_instructions: Apply on SEEK (no link out). SEEK questions: right to work, expected salary, years as a civil engineer, notice period, FIFO/DIDO experience.
